title: BPA Large-Load Request Registry — normalized project layer
purpose: Non-additive normalization of BPA large-load request records already retained in the repository project-evidence layer. Preserves request IDs, published capacity claims, status, location/POI fields, source provenance and display-geometry precision without promoting these records into the nine-market geographic core.

source.name: BPA Large Load Registry / secondary reproduction
source.source_authority: secondary reproduction / normalization of public BPA large-load request information
source.raw_source_semantics: Official BPA source URL is retained as the authoritative source family. Row-level values in this layer come from the retained secondary reproductions because the official row-level snapshot is not bundled.

source_population_accounting.coverage_statement: The public secondary page exposes the 50 largest live requests, while reporting 457 requests on record and 289 live requests. This repository layer therefore is not a complete 457-row BPA transcription; it retains the 50 displayed live rows plus 10 additional records already present in the project-evidence layer. Full row-level capture requires an authoritative spreadsheet snapshot or another source exposing the remaining records.

records.notes: Public secondary cross-reference of a BPA large-load request. The displayed BPA ledger does not identify this as a data center unless the project name itself does so. Capacity is requested load, not contracted or energized demand. Transmission/substation names are retained because the source classifies them as large-load requests. Current cross-check adds BPA request ID and POI/status from Substation Scout's reproduction of the BPA published spreadsheet; the source explicitly says requested MW are as filed and not study results or entitlements.
